product: Serverless log delivery to Unity Catalog volumes (Beta)
tagline: Workspace admins can now deliver serverless job application logs to a Unity Catalog volume for retention and analysis.
what_it_does: Workspace admins can now deliver serverless job application logs to a Unity Catalog volume for retention and analysis. Serverless log delivery writes application logs from serverless jobs to a Unity Catalog volume. Workspace admins configure a destination for the workspace so that teams can retain logs and process them with their observability tools.
plain_summary: Workspace admins can now deliver serverless job application logs to a Unity Catalog volume for retention and analysis.
key_takeaway: Workspace admins can now deliver serverless job application logs to a Unity Catalog volume for retention and analysis.
